import json, os, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agentos_node.client_cli import _default_config, _default_policy, _load_policy
from agentos_node.thin_client_transport import ClientConfig, build_client

def ps(command):
    try:
        p=subprocess.run(['powershell.exe','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',command],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12,check=False)
        return {'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.strip()[-6000:],'stderr':p.stderr.strip()[-2000:]}
    except Exception as exc:
        return {'error':type(exc).__name__+':'+str(exc)}

config_path=_default_config()
policy_path=_default_policy()
cfg=ClientConfig.load(config_path)
launcher=Path(os.environ.get('LOCALAPPDATA',''))/'AgentOS'/'agentos-client.cmd'
launcher_text=launcher.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') if launcher.exists() else ''
launcher_safe=re.sub(r'(?im)^([^\r\n]*token[^=]*=).*$' , r'\1<redacted>', launcher_text)
task=ps("(Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AgentOS Thin Client' -ErrorAction Stop).Actions | Select-Object Execute,Arguments,WorkingDirectory | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
procs=ps("Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)agentos_node|agentos-client' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
health=None
health_error=None
try:
    health=build_client(cfg,_load_policy(policy_path)).health()
except Exception as exc:
    health_error=type(exc).__name__+':'+str(exc)
sources='\n'.join([str(config_path),cfg.one_url,launcher_safe,json.dumps(task,ensure_ascii=False),json.dumps(procs,ensure_ascii=False),os.environ.get('AGENTOS_CLIENT_HOME','')])
out={
    'schema':'agentos.node-effective-runtime/v1',
    'config_path':str(config_path),
    'policy_path':str(policy_path),
    'agentos_client_home':os.environ.get('AGENTOS_CLIENT_HOME'),
    'one_url':cfg.one_url,
    'realm_id':cfg.realm_id,
    'node_id':cfg.node_id,
    'launcher_path':str(launcher),
    'launcher_exists':launcher.exists(),
    'launcher':launcher_safe[-4000:],
    'scheduled_task_action':task,
    'client_processes':procs,
    'health':health,
    'health_error':health_error,
    'contains_8787':('8787' in sources),
}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
